Why the Quran is from God

One message, twenty-three years

The Quran invites close reading, and says a book from any other source would hold much inconsistency.

It came in parts over about twenty-three years, through persecution, exile, war, grief and victory. The Quran invites you to read closely, and says that a book from other than God would show much inconsistency. Rulings changed with the setting, and the Quran says so. What holds is the centre: one God, accountability, mercy, justice. Read it, and see whether that centre moves.

﴿أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۚ وَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ غَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا۟ فِيهِ ٱخْتِلَـٰفًا كَثِيرًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān? If it had been from [any] other than Allāh, they would have found within it much contradiction.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:82

﴿وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.

Quran · Al-Furqan 25:32

﴿ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:23

You might ask

QuestionCritics list contradictions. What about those?
AnswerEach deserves a fair reading. Many ease with context, and some stay hard. Hard is not the same as contradictory, and the verse asks you to weigh the whole book.Quran · An-Nisa 4:82
QuestionDidn't its laws change over time?
AnswerYes, and it says so itself. A verse may give way to a better or an equal one. Rulings moved with the setting. The centre of the message did not.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:106
QuestionCouldn't one gifted person stay this consistent?
AnswerA critic can say so, and coherence alone settles nothing. The Quran invites you to read and see. It is one sign, to be weighed with the rest.Quran · Az-Zumar 39:23

Twenty-three changing years, and one centre: God, accountability, mercy, justice.
